scope: huabei original128 spring same DEM solar space interpolation integral
run_gate: no visibility query unless explicitly approved cap covers the complete protocol
timed_path: common receiver loop, solar/visibility/statistics, query checks and scalar result copies; result arrays allocated before timer; formal detailed logs and node retention disabled for both
old_results: regression only, never substitute for a timed baseline pass
pass_criterion: all saved-input/history regressions and per-pixel repeat checks pass; report each paired time and error even if slower or nonzero; no automatic expansion
decision: fresh same-batch timing distinguishes reproducible local time benefit from cross-batch observation; untriggered dark branch remains unvalidated
cost_estimate: about 25 seconds compute from old medians for 8 full passes; diagnostic node output, input load and JVM/GC extra; estimate not a new measurement
diagnostics: full nodes and boundary/window accuracy saved in excluded warmups; each formal pass saves scalar PSD/query/status/reason/branch for all pixels after all timings; formal repeat checks compare these scalars and aggregate visibility/spatial counts, not per-round node maps
